CH-001.tx: Jump on the spot, crossing your feet on every jump, with your hands up like kangaroo paws.

CH-002.tx: Stand on one leg like a flamingo, arms out like wings, without putting the other foot down.

CH-004.tx: Close your eyes and touch your nose, then your ear, then your chin, without a mistake and without opening your eyes.

CH-005.tx: Strike a hero pose and freeze, even if the others pull funny faces at you (without touching you).

CH-006.tx: On tiptoe, pretend to catch a star high above you, without dropping back onto your heels.

CH-007.tx: Walk 6 steps placing your heel right in front of your toes, as if on a rope above a river full of crocodiles.

CH-008.tx: Put a small cushion on your head like a crown and walk like a king or a queen, without dropping it.

CH-009.tx: Hold your right ear with your left hand and your nose with your right hand, then swap as fast as you can, 4 times in a row.

CH-010.tx: Lift one knee and count to 10 in a pirate voice, without putting your foot down. "One, matey! Two…"

CH-012.tx: Take 8 steps like a robot whose batteries are nearly flat: slower and slower… until it breaks down!

CH-014.tx: Arms out like the wings of a plane, make the engine noise and lean into the turns without falling.

CH-016.tx: Pass a small cushion from one hand to the other under your raised leg, without dropping it.

CH-017.tx: Take 5 slow-motion giant steps, saying in a deep voice: "I am the giant… and I am hungry!"

CH-018.tx: Take 10 busy-ant steps, tiny and very fast, whispering "sorry, sorry, I am late!".

CH-019.tx: A player of your choice makes 3 slow moves: copy them at the same time, like their reflection in a mirror.

CH-020.tx: Do it all without stopping: flamingo for 5 seconds, 5 crossed-feet jumps, then touch your nose with your eyes closed.

CH-021.tx: Roar like a lion trying to be very scary… but who sneezes every time!

CH-022.tx: Moo like a cow, louder and louder… then softer and softer, until you fall asleep snoring.

CH-023.tx: Be a cat begging for cuddles: meow very softly and purr for 5 seconds.

CH-024.tx: Make a trunk with your arm, trumpet like an elephant and pretend to spray the whole family.

CH-025.ti: The hen and the giant egg
CH-025.tx: Be a hen that has just laid a giant egg, until a player guesses the animal.

CH-026.tx: Get the others to guess a frog without talking: little crouching jumps and a tongue catching flies.

CH-027.tx: Walk 5 steps like a penguin sliding on ice, arms tight against your body.

CH-028.tx: Get the others to guess a fish without a sound: mouth opening and closing, fins wiggling.

CH-029.tx: Get the others to guess a rabbit that is very scared of a fox, using gestures only.

CH-030.tx: Get the others to guess a giraffe trying to reach the leaves at the top of the tree, without talking.

CH-031.tx: Do the dog, the sheep and the donkey sounds one after the other, as fast as you can and without laughing.

CH-032.tx: Think of an animal. The others have 5 yes-or-no questions to find it. If they fail, you win!

CH-033.tx: The player on your right whispers an animal in your ear. Get the others to guess it without talking, in under 30 seconds.

CH-034.tx: Get the others to guess an animal of your choice using only its sound, with your hands behind your back.

CH-035.tx: Get the others to guess an animal of your choice with gestures only, without a sound… not even a giggle!

CH-036.tx: Name 5 animals in 10 seconds… in a tiny mouse voice.

CH-037.tx: Name an animal for each letter of your first name.

CH-038.tx: Name an animal that lives in water, one that flies in the sky and one that lives in the desert, in 15 seconds.

CH-039.tx: Get the others to guess 3 animals in under 40 seconds: one with gestures, one with its sound, one with both.

CH-040.tx: Invent an animal by mixing two animals (an "elephenguin"!), give it a name and show what it can do.

CH-041.tx: Kiss each member of your family who agrees on the forehead.

CH-042.tx: Give each player a sincere compliment, in the voice of a news presenter announcing big news.

CH-043.tx: Name a quality of the player on your left, as if you were giving them a gold medal.

CH-044.tx: Thank a player for something specific.

CH-045.tx: Invent a special high-five (up, down, to the side…) and do it with every player who agrees.

CH-046.tx: Invent a very simple handshake with a player who agrees.

CH-048.tx: Get the whole table clapping: first with one finger, then two, then whole hands, louder and louder!

CH-049.tx: Choose a player and wish them something good, like a wizard casting a kind spell.

CH-050.tx: Say one thing you love about your family.

CH-051.tx: Give 5 Kounouz to the player of your choice. If you do, win 15 Kounouz.

CH-052.tx: Give 10 Kounouz to the player with the fewest Kounouz. Then you win 20 Kounouz.

CH-053.tx: Choose: keep 10 Kounouz, or give 5 to two players and win 25 Kounouz.

CH-054.tx: Say an encouraging sentence to the person with the fewest Kounouz.

CH-055.tx: Complete 3 missions: a compliment, a specific thank you and a kind gesture without contact.

CH-056.tx: Until your next turn, you may not say "yes" or "no". The others will try to trick you!

CH-057.tx: Until your next turn, you cannot talk: you can only communicate with gestures.

CH-058.tx: Until your next turn, only speak in a whisper, like a spy on a secret mission.

CH-059.tx: Until your next turn, speak with a robot voice.

CH-060.tx: For 30 seconds, try not to laugh while the others try to make you laugh without touching you.

CH-061.tx: Keep the most serious face in the world while each player says a funny word to you.

CH-062.tx: Until your next turn, you are not allowed to say the word "Kounouz".

CH-063.tx: For 30 seconds, don't say your own first name.

CH-064.tx: Until your next turn, start every sentence with "O noble family…".

CH-065.tx: Stay in a statue pose while the next player starts their turn.

CH-066.tx: Until your next turn, keep one hand on your head as if you were holding a hat in the wind.

CH-067.tx: Until your next turn, speak in a tiny mouse voice.

CH-068.tx: The player on your left picks an everyday word ("water", "turn"…). Avoid saying it until your next turn.

CH-069.tx: For 30 seconds: don't say "yes" or "no" and keep one hand on your head.

CH-070.tx: One after another: 20 seconds without laughing + 10 seconds of silence + an animal call.

CH-071.tx: Look around you for 10 seconds, close your eyes and name objects in the room.

CH-072.tx: The player on your right slowly says a sequence of numbers. Repeat it without a mistake.

CH-073.tx: The player on your right says: "At the market I bought…" and a list of things. Repeat them in the right order.

CH-074.tx: Point, in order, to something red, something blue and something yellow around you, as fast as you can.

CH-075.tx: A player puts some objects in front of you. Close your eyes: they hide one. Find which!

CH-076.tx: Name fruits in 15 seconds, pretending to bite into each one.

CH-079.tx: Find 3 things around you the same colour as your pawn, in 15 seconds.

CH-080.tx: Find words that start with the first letter of your first name.

CH-081.tx: Make a sentence with these 3 words: camel, umbrella and couscous.

CH-084.tx: Make up a riddle and ask the family. If someone solves it, you win!

CH-085.tx: The player on your right names some objects. Work out 7 + 5, then repeat all the objects in order.

CH-086.tx: Say 3 Arabic words you know and what they mean in English.

CH-088.tx: Count in Arabic up to the number asked.

CH-091.tx: Recite a surah already validated for your level.

CH-092.tx: Recite two short surahs you already know well.

CH-098.tx: Do it all: a simple movement challenge + an animal challenge + a memory challenge.

CH-099.tx: Give a sincere compliment to 2 players, then answer a knowledge question suited to you.

CH-100.tx: Complete 3 trials: a fun trial, a memory or logic trial, then a knowledge trial.

CH-101.tx: Cross the room walking sideways like a crab, snapping your claws.

CH-102.tx: Pretend to score a goal in slow motion… and celebrate in slow motion too!

CH-103.tx: Press your hands together: they are magnetic! Try to pull them apart for 10 seconds, pulling big effort faces.

CH-104.tx: Be a monkey scratching its head, finding a banana, peeling it and eating it with a big grin, without talking.

CH-105.tx: Walk like a very tired camel looking for water, then drink from an imaginary oasis with a big "aaah!".

CH-106.tx: Until your next turn, repeat the last sentence said by the player before you, like a parrot.

CH-107.tx: Until your next turn, talk like a weather presenter: "Bright sunshine over the board, a few clouds over the Maktaba…"

CH-108.tx: Be the waiter in a fancy restaurant: take every player’s imaginary order, with lots of fancy manners.

CH-109.tx: In 20 seconds, tell a funny memory the family shared.

CH-110.tx: Say it 3 times, very fast and without a slip: "Six slick camels seek six shiny scarves."

CH-111.tx: Invent a funny machine to help at home and explain in 20 seconds how it works.

HS-001.title: Offer a meal
HS-001.text: Offer a meal to another player.

HS-002.title: Offer an ʿUmra
HS-002.text: Offer an ʿUmra to another player.

HS-003.title: Help a player
HS-003.text: Give Kounouz to another player who needs them.
